maxillary_keypoint_topology.keypoint_spatial_matrix: The top row keypoints are situated approximately 25% higher than the primary dense row, with a wider horizontal distribution. The angle between the lateral-most top row keypoint and the corresponding point in the second row is approximately 75 degrees.

rhinarium_pixel_ratio.melanin_saturation_percentage: Approximately 95-98% melanin saturation. The rhinarium is predominantly dark with high pixel density in the black-to-dark-grey spectrum; minimal pale/pink pixels are only detectable at the inner margins of the nostrils.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: A cluster of approximately 4-6 small, dark punctate marks/scars is visible on the bridge of the nose, superior to the rhinarium. A small irregular notch is present on the outer margin of the right ear (viewer's left).
other_distinctive_markers: Specific asymmetric distribution of dark spotting on the mid-muzzle bridge, forming a non-linear cluster distinct from the vibrissae spots.
